summary: Technical documentation detailing hook integration configurations, payload schemas, and local verification procedures for various AI agent environments supported by ClankerLog.
responsibilities: Define schema for stdin JSON payloads per integrated agent (Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Hermes, Topchester, Pi, OpenClaw).
Document the interface between agent-specific hooks and the ClankerLog CLI hook commands.
Provide diagnostic command patterns for `clankerlog-dev` and official binary hooks.
Detail the installation and uninstallation procedures for agent-specific hook files and configurations.
Specify privacy boundaries regarding ignored agent data like transcripts, messages, and secrets.
